prescriptions.description: Publish knowledge-base content covering Premium Card enquiries, so the agent has something to answer from. Target: premium_card_info.

predicted_delta_plain.name: kb_lookup.miss
predicted_delta_plain.definition: Share of knowledge-base lookup steps that came back with no confident hit.

decision.asking_approval_for: Publish knowledge-base content covering Premium Card enquiries, so the agent has something to answer from. Or reject and route these questions to a human queue instead.
decision.risk_if_diagnosis_wrong: Low, and recoverable. The likeliest alternative is that these questions are genuinely outside this agent's scope - in which case the content is added, nothing regresses, the number simply does not move, and the right answer is a routing rule instead. No existing behaviour changes either way.
decision.would_not_ship_if: We would not ship this if the golden-set replay regresses any known-good conversation, or the business confirms this product line is being withdrawn or repriced - in which case the answer is a routing rule, not new content nobody will maintain.

prescriptions.description: Make the get_order_status tool check the payload it gets back and treat an empty response as a failure instead of a success. Target: get_order_status.

predicted_delta_plain.name: tool_call.empty
predicted_delta_plain.definition: Share of tool call steps that returned ok with zero fields in the payload. Derived, not declared: the step reports success, so every error-rate metric reads flat while this one moves.

decision.asking_approval_for: Make the get_order_status tool check the payload it gets back and treat an empty response as a failure instead of a success. Or reject and take it up with the team that owns the upstream service.
decision.risk_if_diagnosis_wrong: Moderate. The likeliest alternative is that an empty payload is a legitimate upstream state - 'no records found' rather than a failure. Validation would then convert silent wrong answers into visible errors: better for the customer, but the declared error rate will rise and will look like a new problem to anyone watching that chart.
decision.would_not_ship_if: We would not ship this if the golden-set replay regresses any known-good conversation, or the team that owns the upstream service confirms an empty payload is an expected state, in which case the agent's wording needs to change, not its checks.

prescriptions.description: Edit the prompt behind the acme_main_v3 agent to remove the extra confirmation steps it gained, keeping the wording that carries a compliance purpose. Target: acme_main_v3.

predicted_delta_plain.name: s.cost_usd
predicted_delta_plain.definition: Model spend per conversation, summed over its llm_call steps. Only agents that emit llm_call steps record cost at all, so this carries its tenant's coverage and is never blended across tenants.

decision.asking_approval_for: Edit the prompt behind the acme_main_v3 agent to remove the extra confirmation steps it gained, keeping the wording that carries a compliance purpose. Or reject and keep the current wording if it was added deliberately.
decision.risk_if_diagnosis_wrong: Moderate, and partly a business call. The likeliest alternative is that the extra confirmation turns were added deliberately, for safety or compliance. Editing them back out would trade cost and customer time for risk the business may have accepted on purpose - which is why this is being asked rather than applied.
decision.would_not_ship_if: We would not ship this if the golden-set replay regresses any known-good conversation, or the wording being removed turns out to carry a compliance sign-off - reverting that is a compliance decision, not an engineering one.

gaps.why: cost_per_session is computable only on 72% of acme-bank, because cost is only emitted on llm_call steps, which v2_flow lacks. We report it with its denominator stated rather than blending the tenants into one figure that describes neither. This is not a sample - it is a structural blind spot: the excluded traffic cannot produce the number at all.
no failover mechanism exists in the runtime, so no failover event is ever emitted. There is no primary/secondary path to observe.
gaps.why_the_proxy_misleads: but those are QUALITY retries at a different temperature, not failovers. Reporting them as failover would under-report and read as '0% failover', i.e. as good news.

gaps.why: session_end='abandoned' is MEASURED. WHY the user abandoned is a judgment about meaning and needs a versioned judged signal with a published calibration. Inferring it from the end code is a Rule 1 violation dressed up as an aggregate.
gaps.why_the_proxy_misleads: it counts everyone who left, including users who got their answer and simply stopped replying; the question is why
